manifest.help_text: Run manifest: a TSV with a header row and one data row per species. Columns: species (used as the output folder name), metadata (path to a .tsv/.csv), assemblies (path to a directory or a .txt list), target_groups (optional, comma-separated lineage labels). When unset, use --metadata / --assembly_input directly for a single species. Multi-row manifests are not supported yet (see PAT-3569).
